verdict.rationale: A state tax and workforce agency could plausibly publish third-party or agent authorization rules, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only registration, wage reporting, QuickFile, account updates and general services. Nothing in the pack describes authorization forms, delegate roles, or which signatures must remain personal to the employer.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
